purpose: Deterministic scenario bank for AquaMind AI development, system evaluation, and demonstration.
disclaimer: These datasets are synthetic. They must not be represented as telemetry collected from a real desalination plant.

normal_operation.csv.description: Stable synthetic RO operation with small measurement variation.

scaling_colloidal_fouling.csv.description: Progressive flow decline, rejection degradation, and pressure-drop increase.

biofouling.csv.description: Flow decline and pressure-drop increase with comparatively stable rejection.

organic_fouling.csv.description: Flow decline while pressure drop and rejection remain comparatively stable.

membrane_integrity_issue.csv.description: Increased permeate flow accompanied by degraded salt rejection.

compaction_mechanical_change.csv.description: Flow decline with increased rejection and comparatively stable pressure drop.

unclassified_abnormal.csv.description: Abnormal combination deliberately outside the supported diagnostic patterns.

membrane_fouling.csv.description: Compatibility alias used by the existing end-to-end runtime success test.

corrupted_recoverable.csv.description: Contains an invalid timestamp, non-numeric sensor reading, missing readings, duplicate timestamp, and out-of-order rows.

insufficient_evidence.csv.description: Structurally valid dataset with too little trend information for a supported diagnosis.
